## Summary

Describe the change and its work packet. Link the evidence report.

## Verification

List the exact checks run and their results. Identify anything unrun or blocked.
Compiler changes also require the approved-binary `test:boris` gate.

## Security and scope

Describe any changes to source access, process execution, credentials, network
access, or publication. Do not include secrets or private source content.
Report vulnerabilities privately using the route in SECURITY.md.
